subject: SOURCE-CONFIRMED: fresh app process can adopt surviving shell cover lease across serviceEpoch
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-state-rd-process-recovery-20261001. Revalidated against main 45bb0d326899c0e08415928224cfea0ff58d2d4e. The app-side Fold7CoverLeaseSnapshotGate is fresh after process death, but FoldOverlayService.onServiceConnected -> Shizuku Ready calls continuity.onPrivilegedReady() before continuity.arm(). onPrivilegedReady() calls reconcileCoverLease("shizuku-ready"). With no prior local snapshot, reconcile sends shellSession=0; DuoShellService COVER_PANEL_LEASE_V3 reconcile explicitly treats zero as a wildcard and returns the current daemon-side Fold7CoverPanelLease snapshot. ShizukuBridge configures the UserService with daemon(true), so its process/HELD lease is intentionally capable of surviving app-process death. The fresh app gate accepts that non-IDLE snapshot/token under its new connectionEpoch because the token identity contains shellSession+leaseId+leaseEpoch+ownerGeneration+physicalDisplayId but no AccessibilityService serviceEpoch. Result: privileged cover authority created by a dead service instance can be adopted as currentToken by a new service instance before the new controller is armed and before any new closeCycle exists. arm() cancels only a locally active Gen2 cycle (none), resets controller from instantaneous topology/angle, and hideMirror() does not release the secondary cover lease. Subsequent topology reconcile does nothing while shell lease state is HELD. This is distinct from prior Shizuku-daemon-restart R&D: here the privileged daemon survives while the app/accessibility process restarts. PROVISIONAL_FIX_DIRECTION: add an app service/recovery epoch to shell lease authority or explicitly classify first non-IDLE snapshot after fresh app startup as FOREIGN_PRIOR_SERVICE and reconcile/release it before renderOwnershipArmed/new cycle authority; do not silently join it. No production writes.
